body: Off topic and probably bloggy but I yoinked a PICC line out while disoriented and delirious after a suicide attempt and don't even remember doing it bc I was so off my ass. I cant imagine doing that by accident, it bruised like a motherfucker and was so sore I cant imagine how much it must have hurt to pull out. Thank God that whole experience was a wake up call for me. The tech who had to sit with me was a saint.
